lesson.name: Learn The London And Colle Systems
lesson.description: Learn the key ideas for both sides in the popular London System, and the solid Colle System.

{How can White lure the black queen to c5 to prepare an amazing tactic?} 11.
Bxd6 {[%wrong There's a better move. Try again.] [%hint Use forcing moves to
lure the black queen to a vulnerable position.]} (11. dxc5 $2 Bxc5 {Black is
OK. Try again and look for a better capture.}) (11. Bxh7+ $2 Kxh7 {White
doesn't have compensation for the missing piece. Try again.}) (11. Qh5 $2 g6 {
Black is OK. Try again and look for a strong capture.}) 11... Qxd6 {Good
start! How can you lure the black queen forward again?} 12. dxc5 {[%wrong
There's a better move to make the black queen move. Try again.] [%hint Attack
Black's queen.] Great job! You've lured the Black queen into the open and can
play a great tactic in the next challenge.} (12. Bxh7+ $2 Kxh7 {White doesn't
have compensation for the sacrificed material. Try again and look for a
stronger capture.}) (12. Qh5 $2 g6 {Black is OK. Try again and look for a
strong capture.}) 1-0

{What amazing sacrifice did GM Kamsky play here?} 13. Bxh7+ {[%wrong Black is
OK. Look for a good sacrifice and try again.] [%hint Sacrifice to draw out the
black king.]} (13. Qh5 $2 g6 {Black is OK. Try again and look for another way
to attack the kingside.}) 13... Kxh7 {Good start. How can you develop with
check?} 14. Qh5+ {[%wrong There's a better move. Look for a good check and try
again.] [%hint Develop your queen with check.]} (14. Qc2+ $2 {The queen's too
far from Black's king to be a helpful attacker. Try again.}) (14. Qb1+ $2 {
The queen's too far from Black's king to be a helpful attacker. Try again.})
14... Kg8 {Good move! How can you bring your knight to the kingside with tempo?
} 15. Ne4 {[%wrong There's a better move. Try again.] [%hint Take advantage of
a pin along the fifth rank.]} (15. Nf3 $2 f6 {There's a faster way to attack.
Black can prevent your knight from reaching g5. Try again.}) 15... Qc4 {
Good move. How can you set up a deadly mate threat?} 16. Ng5 {[%wrong That
doesn't threaten mate. Try again.] [%hint Aim to checkmate on h7.] Well
played! White threatens mate on h7 and Black has no fully adequate defense.
Kamsky went on to win a brilliant game.} (16. Nf6+ $2 gxf6 {Black is winning.
Try again.}) 1-0

{How should Black recapture the white knight?} 10... Qxd7 {[%wrong There's a
better move. Try again and look for a strong capture.] [%hint Recapture but
don't develop your bishop to the potentially vulnerable d7-square.]} (10...
Bxg3 $2 11. Bxh7+ {White meets Kxh7 with Nxf8+ and then hxg3+, leaving Black's
king in terrible trouble. Try again and look for a better capture.}) (10...
Bxd7 $2 11. Bxd6 {White has a winning attack, as we witnessed in the previous
challenges. Try again and look for a stronger capture.}) 11. Bxd6 {Very
precise! See if you can avoid losing material to White's upcoming combination.}
Qxd6 {[%wrong White has too much material. Try again and look for a strong
capture.] [%hint Recapture the bishop.]} 12. dxc5 {Nice move! How should you
meet dxc5?} Qxc5 {[%wrong Why let White win material? Try again and look for a
good capture.] [%hint Recapture the pawn.]} 13. Bxh7+ {The sacrifice looks
scary, but Black is OK. What should you play?} Kxh7 {[%wrong Illegal] [%hint
Capture the bishop.]} (13... Kh8 $2 14. Qh5 {White has a winning attack. Try
again and look for a stronger move.}) 14. Qh5+ {No choices here.} Kg8 {[%wrong
Illegal] [%hint Retreat your king.] Good work! Black is temporarily ahead by a
piece. You can find a safe response to White's attack in the next challenge.} *

{White threatens Nxc5 and Ng5. How can Black defend?} 15... g6 {[%wrong White
wins material. Try again and check the hint if you're stuck.] [%hint Attack
the white queen.] Good idea! Because there is no bishop on d7, White would end
up down material if the queens trade. After Qg5, White has no more than a
perpetual check after any logical queen move from Black.} (15... Qe7 $2 16. Ng5
{White has a devastating kingside attack. Try again and look for a strong
counterattacking move.}) (15... Qb6 $2 16. Ng5 {White has a devastating
kingside attack. Try again and look for a strong counterattacking move.}) (
15... Qb5 $2 16. Ng5 {White has a devastating kingside attack. Try again and
look for a strong counterattacking move.}) (15... Qa5 $2 16. Ng5 {White has a
devastating kingside attack. Try again and look for a strong counterattacking
move.}) (15... dxe4 $2 16. Qxc5 {White has a devastating kingside attack. Try
again and look for a strong counterattacking move.}) *

{How can Black develop with a useful threat?} 7... Bf5 {[%wrong There's a
stronger move. Try to find a way to develop and attack a white piece.] [%hint
Develop and attempt to decoy the white queen from defending the b2-pawn.]} (7...
Nh5 $2 8. Be5 {It's stronger to develop and make a threat at the same time.
How should you do it?}) (7... g6 $2 8. h3 {It's stronger to develop and make a
threat at the same time. How should you do it?}) (7... Bg4 $2 8. Nbd2 {White
has a comfortable position. Try again and look for a stronger bishop move.}) 8.
Qxf5 {White would have been better off playing Qc1 instead of accepting the
bishop sacrifice. What should Black play next?} Qxb2 {[%wrong There's a better
option. Try again and look for a good capture.] [%hint Capture an undefended
pawn.] Well done! Black will win the white rook next turn and should win the
game.} *

{White threatens a pawn fork on e5. How should Black defend?} 9... Be7 {
[%wrong There's a better option. Try again and look for a precise bishop move.]
[%hint Retreat the d6 bishop to avoid a fork and defend the kingside.] Well
played! This precise move avoids a fork and gives Black fully even chances.} (
9... Nh5 $5 10. Bxd6 {This is playable, but the knight is somewhat offside on
h5. Try again and look for a stronger way to avoid a fork on e5.}) (9... dxe4
$2 10. Nxe4 {White is well developed and ready for the opening of the center.
Try again and look for a safer option.}) (9... cxd4 $2 10. e5 {White uses a
fork to win material. Try again and look for a way to keep a solid position
for Black.}) (9... Bxg3 $2 10. hxg3 {White soon generates dangerous threats
against h7. Try again and look for a stronger bishop move.}) (9... Bc7 $2 10.
Bh4 {White wins the f6-knight and Black faces a difficult defense. Try again
and look for a stronger bishop move.}) (9... Bb8 $2 10. Bh4 {White wins the
f6-knight and Black faces a difficult defense. Try again and look for a
stronger bishop move.}) *

{How should White start a strong attack?} 11. e5 {[%wrong There's a stronger
attacking move. Try again and look for a dangerous threat.] [%hint Attack the
f6-knight.]} (11. exd5 $2 exd5 {White's queen will be vulnerable on the e-file.
Try again and look for a stronger pawn move.}) 11... Ng4 {Black saves the
knight, but it's not well-placed on g4. How should White take advantage?} 12.
Bxh7+ {[%wrong There's a better attacking move. Try again and look for a way
to expose the black king.] [%hint Sacrifice a piece to lure the black king
into danger.]} (12. Ng5 $2 f5 {The e5-pawn is pinned against mate on h2. Try
again and look for a stronger move to take advantage of the vulnerable black
kingside.}) (12. h3 $2 Ngxe5 {Black wins a key pawn. Try again and look for a
stronger attacking idea.}) 12... Kxh7 {Great move! How should you win back the
sacrificed piece?} 13. Ng5+ {[%wrong There's a stronger option. Try again and
look for a precise check.] [%hint Check and open a diagonal to target the
g4-knight.]} Kg8 {Good idea! What's next?} 14. Qxg4 {[%wrong Black has too
much material. Try again and look for a strong capture.] [%hint Capture the
knight.] Good work! Black can win back the pawn on e5, but White will maintain
a dangerous kingside initiative.} *

{When Black develops the c8-bishop early against the Colle System, then
White's best option is to transpose to another opening. What should you play?} 
4. c4 {[%wrong There's a better option. Try again and look for a useful pawn
advance.] [%hint Offer to trade your c-pawn for the black d-pawn.] Good work!
White will likely play an early Qb3, to target the undefended b7-pawn and keep
chances for an advantage.} (4. c3 $2 e6 {There's a more useful square for the
c-pawn. Try to find it.}) (4. Be2 $2 e6 {Black has a safe position. Try again
and look for a strong pawn advance.}) (4. Bd3 $2 c5 {Black has a safe position.
Try again and look for a strong pawn advance.}) (4. h3 $5 {This is reasonable,
but another pawn push is more popular. Try to find a way to transpose into a
Queen's Gambit.}) (4. Nbd2 $2 e6 {Black has a safe position. Try again and
look for a strong pawn advance.}) *
